features.name: Ordered firing
features.description: Cylinders fire top to bottom, left to right.

review:
Smokey in a ten-gallon hat on a cluster grid with Super Cascades. When a winning cluster includes a wild, that wild turns into a revolver cylinder with two to six shots, which fires once all the cascades have settled.

Each shot hits a spot on the grid (the same spot can be hit twice), setting off reveals. Several cylinders fire in order, top to bottom, left to right. With a 25,000x max it has the biggest ceiling of the Le games – and the most Wild West attitude.
